module

public import KimiK3.FeedForward
public import KimiK3.Sequence
public import KimiK3.Vision

/-!
# Composed Kimi K3 language model

The other Kimi K3 modules specify individual operations, and this file puts them in backbone
order. AttnRes retrieves the input to a sequence mixer (KDA or Gated MLA), a second AttnRes
retrieval feeds the dense or Stable LatentMoE channel mixer, and the result is recorded into the
current depth block.  A final AttnRes query aggregates the retained block representations before
the vocabulary projection. Sparse layers compute their top-k routes from their own adjusted router
scores, and `Route.chooseTopK` breaks score ties by expert index.

Reference: Kimi Team, "Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence", 2026, Figure 2, p. 3, and
Sections 2.1--2.4, pp. 4--10, https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace KimiK3

open TorchLean
open Tensor

/-- Either recurrent KDA or global Gated MLA at one backbone layer. -/
inductive SequenceMixer (α : Type) [Storage α] (cfg : TextConfig) (decayRank : Nat) where
  | kda :
      KDA.Layer α cfg.hiddenDim cfg.numHeads cfg.kdaHeadDim cfg.kdaValueDim
        cfg.shortConvWidth decayRank → α → SequenceMixer α cfg decayRank
  | mla :
      GatedMLA α cfg.hiddenDim cfg.numHeads cfg.queryLatentDim cfg.kvLatentDim
        cfg.qkNopeHeadDim cfg.qkReservedHeadDim cfg.valueHeadDim → SequenceMixer α cfg decayRank

namespace SequenceMixer

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {cfg : TextConfig} {decayRank : Nat}

/-- Schedule tag of a concrete sequence mixer. -/
def kind : SequenceMixer α cfg decayRank → AttentionKind
  | .kda _ _ => .kda
  | .mla _ => .mla

/-- Cache or state carried between causal token steps: KDA's recurrent matrices and short
convolution history, or MLA's compressed latent cache. -/
def CausalState : (mixer : SequenceMixer α cfg decayRank) → Type
  | .kda _ _ =>
      KDA.Layer.ScanState α cfg.hiddenDim cfg.numHeads cfg.kdaHeadDim cfg.kdaValueDim
  | .mla _ => GatedMLA.Cache α cfg.kvLatentDim cfg.qkReservedHeadDim

/-- Empty causal state for either sequence mixer. -/
def initialState (mixer : SequenceMixer α cfg decayRank) : mixer.CausalState :=
  match mixer with
  | .kda _ _ =>
      let headState : KDA.Layer.State α cfg.numHeads cfg.kdaHeadDim cfg.kdaValueDim :=
        Tensor.zeros [cfg.numHeads, cfg.kdaHeadDim, cfg.kdaValueDim]
      (headState, [])
  | .mla _ => []

/-- Advance KDA or Gated MLA by one token, returning the updated causal state and the output. -/
def step (mixer : SequenceMixer α cfg decayRank) (state : mixer.CausalState)
    (token : Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    mixer.CausalState × Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim] :=
  match mixer with
  | .kda layer logFloor => layer.scanStep logFloor state token
  | .mla layer => layer.step state token

/-- Run one sequence mixer over a token list, starting from its empty state. -/
def forward (mixer : SequenceMixer α cfg decayRank)
    (tokens : List (Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim])) :
    List (Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim]) :=
  (CausalScan.run mixer.step mixer.initialState tokens).2

/-- An empty sequence produces no mixed representations. -/
@[simp] theorem forward_nil (mixer : SequenceMixer α cfg decayRank) :
    mixer.forward [] = [] := by
  simp [forward]

/-- Both sequence mixers return one representation per input token. -/
theorem forward_length (mixer : SequenceMixer α cfg decayRank)
    (tokens : List (Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim])) :
    (mixer.forward tokens).length = tokens.length := by
  exact CausalScan.outputs_length mixer.step mixer.initialState tokens

end SequenceMixer

/-- Dense FFN of the leading layers, or the sparse Stable LatentMoE used by later layers. -/
inductive ChannelMixer (α : Type) [Storage α] (cfg : TextConfig) where
  | dense : Expert α cfg.hiddenDim cfg.denseHiddenDim cfg.hiddenDim → ChannelMixer α cfg
  | sparse :
      StableLatentMoE α cfg.hiddenDim cfg.routedLatentDim cfg.routedExpertHiddenDim
        cfg.routedExpertHiddenDim cfg.numSharedExperts cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.activeExperts →
      ChannelMixer α cfg

namespace ChannelMixer

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {cfg : TextConfig}

/-- Whether this channel mixer is the dense FFN. -/
def isDense : ChannelMixer α cfg → Bool
  | .dense _ => true
  | .sparse _ => false

/-- Evaluate one token with a given route (dense layers ignore it). Useful for checking a backend
selector against the mathematical top-k route. -/
def forwardGivenRoute (mixer : ChannelMixer α cfg)
    (route : Route cfg.numRoutedExperts cfg.activeExperts)
    (x : Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim]) : Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim] :=
  match mixer with
  | .dense expert => expert.forward (cfg.situGateCap : α) (cfg.situUpCap : α) x
  | .sparse moe => moe.forward route (cfg.situGateCap : α) (cfg.situUpCap : α) x

/-- Evaluate a real-valued channel mixer on one token. Sparse layers choose their experts from the
adjusted router scores, and dense layers need no routing decision. -/
noncomputable def forward (mixer : ChannelMixer ℝ cfg)
    (hActive : cfg.activeExperts ≤ cfg.numRoutedExperts)
    (x : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim]) : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim] :=
  match mixer with
  | .dense expert => expert.forward cfg.situGateCap cfg.situUpCap x
  | .sparse moe => moe.forwardReal hActive cfg.situGateCap cfg.situUpCap x

end ChannelMixer

/-- One K3 backbone layer, including separate AttnRes queries for its two submodules. -/
structure BackboneLayer (α : Type) [Storage α] (cfg : TextConfig) (decayRank : Nat) where
  /-- Learned depth query for the sequence mixer input. -/
  sequenceQuery : Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim]
  /-- RMSNorm scale applied before sequence mixing. -/
  sequenceNormScale : Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim]
  /-- KDA or MLA parameters selected by this layer's schedule position. -/
  sequence : SequenceMixer α cfg decayRank
  /-- Learned depth query for the channel mixer input. -/
  channelQuery : Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim]
  /-- RMSNorm scale applied before channel mixing. -/
  channelNormScale : Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim]
  /-- Dense FFN or routed Stable LatentMoE parameters. -/
  channel : ChannelMixer α cfg

namespace BackboneLayer

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {cfg : TextConfig} {decayRank : Nat}

/-- Initialize the depth-memory state of one token from its embedding. -/
def initialDepthState (embedding : Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    AttnRes.BlockState α cfg.hiddenDim :=
  { embedding
    completedBlocks := []
    partialBlock := Tensor.zeros [cfg.hiddenDim]
    partialSize := 0 }

/-- An initial depth state is valid for every positive AttnRes block size. -/
theorem initialDepthState_wf (embedding : Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim])
    (hBlockSize : 0 < cfg.attnResBlockSize) :
    (initialDepthState embedding).WF cfg.attnResBlockSize := by
  exact hBlockSize

/-- Apply one backbone layer to all tokenwise depth states. -/
noncomputable def forward (layer : BackboneLayer ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (hActive : cfg.activeExperts ≤ cfg.numRoutedExperts)
    (states : List (AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim)) :
    List (AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim) :=
  let sequenceInput := states.map (fun state => state.retrieve layer.sequenceQuery)
  let normalizedSequenceInput := sequenceInput.map
    (fun token => RMSNorm.scale token layer.sequenceNormScale)
  let sequenceOutput := layer.sequence.forward normalizedSequenceInput
  let channelInput := List.zipWith
    (fun state output => state.retrieveAfterSequence output layer.channelQuery) states
    sequenceOutput
  let channelOutput := channelInput.map (fun token =>
    layer.channel.forward hActive (RMSNorm.scale token layer.channelNormScale))
  List.zipWith
    (fun state outputs =>
      state.finishLayer cfg.attnResBlockSize outputs.1 outputs.2)
    states (List.zip sequenceOutput channelOutput)

/-- A layer preserves the number of tokenwise depth states. -/
theorem forward_length (layer : BackboneLayer ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (hActive : cfg.activeExperts ≤ cfg.numRoutedExperts)
    (states : List (AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim)) :
    (layer.forward hActive states).length = states.length := by
  let sequenceInput := states.map (fun state => state.retrieve layer.sequenceQuery)
  let normalizedSequenceInput := sequenceInput.map
    (fun token => RMSNorm.scale token layer.sequenceNormScale)
  let sequenceOutput := layer.sequence.forward normalizedSequenceInput
  let channelInput := List.zipWith
    (fun state output => state.retrieveAfterSequence output layer.channelQuery) states
    sequenceOutput
  let channelOutput := channelInput.map (fun token =>
    layer.channel.forward hActive (RMSNorm.scale token layer.channelNormScale))
  have hSequence : sequenceOutput.length = states.length := by
    rw [layer.sequence.forward_length]
    simp [normalizedSequenceInput, sequenceInput]
  have hChannelInput : channelInput.length = states.length := by
    simp [channelInput, hSequence]
  have hChannel : channelOutput.length = states.length := by
    simp [channelOutput, hChannelInput]
  change (List.zipWith _ states (List.zip sequenceOutput channelOutput)).length = states.length
  simp [hSequence, hChannel]

/-- Advance one backbone layer by a single autoregressive token, threading the sequence mixer's
causal state. Both the streaming decoder and the EAGLE draft are built from this step. -/
noncomputable def forwardToken (layer : BackboneLayer ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (hActive : cfg.activeExperts ≤ cfg.numRoutedExperts)
    (sequenceState : layer.sequence.CausalState)
    (depthState : AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim) :
    layer.sequence.CausalState × AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim :=
  let sequenceInput := RMSNorm.scale (depthState.retrieve layer.sequenceQuery)
    layer.sequenceNormScale
  let sequenceResult := layer.sequence.step sequenceState sequenceInput
  let channelInput := depthState.retrieveAfterSequence sequenceResult.2 layer.channelQuery
  let channelOutput := layer.channel.forward hActive
    (RMSNorm.scale channelInput layer.channelNormScale)
  (sequenceResult.1,
    depthState.finishLayer cfg.attnResBlockSize sequenceResult.2 channelOutput)

/-- Evaluating a layer over the whole sequence agrees with advancing its causal state one token
at a time. This covers the full layer: both AttnRes retrievals, both normalizations, the
sequence mixer, and the routed channel mixer. -/
theorem forward_eq_scan (layer : BackboneLayer ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (hActive : cfg.activeExperts ≤ cfg.numRoutedExperts)
    (states : List (AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim)) :
    layer.forward hActive states =
      (CausalScan.run (layer.forwardToken hActive) layer.sequence.initialState states).2 := by
  let prepare := fun state : AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim =>
    RMSNorm.scale (state.retrieve layer.sequenceQuery) layer.sequenceNormScale
  let finish := fun (state : AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim)
      (output : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim]) =>
    state.finishLayer cfg.attnResBlockSize output
      (layer.channel.forward hActive
        (RMSNorm.scale (state.retrieveAfterSequence output layer.channelQuery)
          layer.channelNormScale))
  have hRun := CausalScan.run_map layer.sequence.step prepare finish
    layer.sequence.initialState states
  change layer.forward hActive states = (CausalScan.run
    (fun current input =>
      let result := layer.sequence.step current (prepare input)
      (result.1, finish input result.2)) layer.sequence.initialState states).2
  rw [hRun]
  simp only
  unfold forward SequenceMixer.forward
  simp only [List.map_map]
  have hZip (xs : List (AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim))
      (outputs : List (Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim])) :
      List.zipWith (fun state outputs =>
        state.finishLayer cfg.attnResBlockSize outputs.1 outputs.2) xs
        (outputs.zip ((xs.zipWith
          (fun state output => state.retrieveAfterSequence output layer.channelQuery)
          outputs).map (fun token => layer.channel.forward hActive
            (RMSNorm.scale token layer.channelNormScale)))) =
        List.zipWith finish xs outputs := by
    induction xs generalizing outputs with
    | nil => simp
    | cons state rest ih =>
      cases outputs with
      | nil => simp
      | cons output outputs =>
        simp only [List.zipWith_cons_cons, List.map_cons, List.zip_cons_cons]
        exact congrArg (List.cons (finish state output)) (ih outputs)
  exact hZip states _

/-- A one-token backbone step preserves the AttnRes block-position invariant. -/
theorem forwardToken_depth_wf (layer : BackboneLayer ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (hActive : cfg.activeExperts ≤ cfg.numRoutedExperts)
    (sequenceState : layer.sequence.CausalState)
    (depthState : AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim)
    (hDepth : depthState.WF cfg.attnResBlockSize) :
    (layer.forwardToken hActive sequenceState depthState).2.WF cfg.attnResBlockSize := by
  simp only [forwardToken]
  exact depthState.finishLayer_wf cfg.attnResBlockSize _ _ hDepth

end BackboneLayer

/-- Complete language-backbone parameter bundle.

Its four proof fields make the architectural invariants part of the model value. Routing
feasibility needs no separate proof, and a caller cannot attach an arbitrary sequence of KDA, MLA,
dense, and sparse layers to a K3 configuration.
-/
structure LanguageModel (α : Type) [Storage α] (cfg : TextConfig) (decayRank : Nat) where
  /-- Shared vocabulary embedding table. -/
  tokenEmbedding : Tensor α [cfg.vocabSize, cfg.hiddenDim]
  /-- Shape-indexed parameters for every configured backbone layer. -/
  layer : Fin cfg.numLayers → BackboneLayer α cfg decayRank
  /-- Final learned query over AttnRes block summaries. -/
  finalQuery : Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim]
  /-- RMSNorm scale applied after final depth retrieval. -/
  finalNormScale : Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim]
  /-- Projection from hidden width to vocabulary logits. -/
  vocabularyHead : Tensor α [cfg.hiddenDim, cfg.vocabSize]
  /-- Nonemptiness required by typed vocabulary operations. -/
  vocabSize_pos : 0 < cfg.vocabSize
  /-- Routing capacity required by every sparse channel mixer. -/
  activeExperts_le : cfg.activeExperts ≤ cfg.numRoutedExperts
  /-- Stored sequence mixers agree with the configured KDA/MLA schedule. -/
  sequenceSchedule : ∀ index, (layer index).sequence.kind = cfg.attentionKindAt index
  /-- Stored channel mixers agree with the configured dense-prefix schedule. -/
  channelSchedule :
    ∀ index, (layer index).channel.isDense = decide (index.val < cfg.firstDenseLayers)

/-- One position in the sequence presented to the shared language backbone.

Text positions index the vocabulary embedding table. Visual positions index the sequence emitted
by MoonViT after temporal pooling, spatial merging, and projection to the language width. With
typed alternatives, the repeated media placeholder of serialized prompts never gets an ordinary
vocabulary meaning.
-/
inductive InputSlot (vocabSize visualTokens : Nat) where
  | text (token : Fin vocabSize)
  | visual (token : Fin visualTokens)
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace LanguageModel

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {cfg : TextConfig} {decayRank : Nat}

/-- Look up a fixed-length sequence of text-token embeddings. -/
def embedText {sequenceLength : Nat} (model : LanguageModel α cfg decayRank)
    (tokens : Fin sequenceLength → Fin cfg.vocabSize) :
    Tensor α [sequenceLength, cfg.hiddenDim] :=
  Tensor.dim fun position => Tensor.unstack model.tokenEmbedding (tokens position)

omit [Context α] in
/-- Text embedding is a row lookup in the shared vocabulary table. -/
@[simp] theorem get_embedText {sequenceLength : Nat} (model : LanguageModel α cfg decayRank)
    (tokens : Fin sequenceLength → Fin cfg.vocabSize) (position : Fin sequenceLength) :
    Tensor.unstack (model.embedText tokens) position =
      Tensor.unstack model.tokenEmbedding (tokens position) := by
  simp [embedText, Tensor.unstack]

/-- Resolve a mixed text/visual sequence into language-width embeddings. Slots play the role of
expanding a serialized media placeholder into MoonViT's visual tokens. -/
def embedMultimodal {sequenceLength visualTokens : Nat}
    (model : LanguageModel α cfg decayRank)
    (visual : Tensor α [visualTokens, cfg.hiddenDim])
    (slots : Fin sequenceLength → InputSlot cfg.vocabSize visualTokens) :
    Tensor α [sequenceLength, cfg.hiddenDim] :=
  Tensor.dim fun position =>
    match slots position with
    | .text token => Tensor.unstack model.tokenEmbedding token
    | .visual token => Tensor.unstack visual token

omit [Context α] in
/-- A text slot is resolved from the vocabulary embedding table. -/
theorem get_embedMultimodal_text {sequenceLength visualTokens : Nat}
    (model : LanguageModel α cfg decayRank)
    (visual : Tensor α [visualTokens, cfg.hiddenDim])
    (slots : Fin sequenceLength → InputSlot cfg.vocabSize visualTokens)
    (position : Fin sequenceLength) (token : Fin cfg.vocabSize)
    (hSlot : slots position = .text token) :
    Tensor.unstack (model.embedMultimodal visual slots) position =
      Tensor.unstack model.tokenEmbedding token := by
  simp [embedMultimodal, hSlot]

omit [Context α] in
/-- A visual slot is resolved from MoonViT's projected token sequence. -/
theorem get_embedMultimodal_visual {sequenceLength visualTokens : Nat}
    (model : LanguageModel α cfg decayRank)
    (visual : Tensor α [visualTokens, cfg.hiddenDim])
    (slots : Fin sequenceLength → InputSlot cfg.vocabSize visualTokens)
    (position : Fin sequenceLength) (token : Fin visualTokens)
    (hSlot : slots position = .visual token) :
    Tensor.unstack (model.embedMultimodal visual slots) position = Tensor.unstack visual token := by
  simp [embedMultimodal, hSlot]

/-- Run MoonViT and splice its projected tokens into a mixed language-model sequence. -/
noncomputable def embedVisionText {visionCfg : VisionConfig}
    {frames rows columns patchFeatures sequenceLength visualTokens : Nat}
    (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (vision : MoonViT.Model ℝ visionCfg patchFeatures)
    (patches : MoonViT.Grid ℝ frames
      (rows * visionCfg.mergeHeight) (columns * visionCfg.mergeWidth) patchFeatures)
    (hFrames : 0 < frames) (hMaxFrames : frames ≤ MoonViT.maxFrames)
    (hSpatial : 0 < (rows * visionCfg.mergeHeight) *
      (columns * visionCfg.mergeWidth))
    (hVisionHidden : 0 < visionCfg.hiddenDim)
    (hVisionText : 0 < visionCfg.textHiddenDim)
    (hVisualTokens : rows * columns = visualTokens)
    (hHidden : visionCfg.textHiddenDim = cfg.hiddenDim)
    (slots : Fin sequenceLength → InputSlot cfg.vocabSize visualTokens) :
    Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, cfg.hiddenDim] := by
  let encoded := vision.forward patches hFrames hMaxFrames hSpatial hVisionHidden hVisionText
  have aligned : Tensor ℝ [visualTokens, cfg.hiddenDim] := by
    simpa [hVisualTokens, hHidden] using encoded
  exact model.embedMultimodal aligned slots

/-- Run every backbone layer and keep the final AttnRes state at each sequence position. EAGLE-3
needs this state because its draft input reads intermediate AttnRes block outputs. -/
noncomputable def forwardDepthStates {sequenceLength : Nat}
    (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (embeddings : Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    Fin sequenceLength → AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim := by
  let initialEmbeddings := List.ofFn fun position => Tensor.unstack embeddings position
  let initial := initialEmbeddings.map BackboneLayer.initialDepthState
  let finalStates := (List.finRange cfg.numLayers).foldl
    (fun states index => (model.layer index).forward model.activeExperts_le states) initial
  have hFoldGeneral : ∀ (indices : List (Fin cfg.numLayers))
      (states : List (AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim)),
      (indices.foldl (fun states index =>
        (model.layer index).forward model.activeExperts_le states) states).length =
        states.length := by
    intro indices
    induction indices with
    | nil => simp
    | cons index rest ih =>
        intro states
        simp only [List.foldl_cons]
        rw [ih]
        exact BackboneLayer.forward_length (model.layer index) model.activeExperts_le states
  have hLength : finalStates.length = sequenceLength := by
    calc
      finalStates.length = initial.length :=
        hFoldGeneral (List.finRange cfg.numLayers) initial
      _ = sequenceLength := by simp [initial, initialEmbeddings]
  exact fun position => finalStates.get ⟨position.val, by rw [hLength]; exact position.isLt⟩

/-- Run the language backbone from already embedded text and/or visual tokens. -/
noncomputable def forwardHidden {sequenceLength : Nat}
    (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (embeddings : Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, cfg.hiddenDim] :=
  Tensor.dim fun position =>
    let state := model.forwardDepthStates embeddings position
    RMSNorm.scale (state.retrieve model.finalQuery) model.finalNormScale

/-- Project final hidden representations to vocabulary logits. -/
noncomputable def logits {sequenceLength : Nat} (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (embeddings : Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, cfg.vocabSize] :=
  Tensor.dim fun position =>
    Tensor.vecmat (Tensor.unstack (model.forwardHidden embeddings) position) model.vocabularyHead

end LanguageModel

module

public import KimiK3.Model
public import Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn
public import TorchLean.Tensor.Operations

/-!
# Sequence evaluation and streaming

Full-sequence evaluation runs each layer over all tokens before the next layer, while a streaming
decoder runs all layers on one token before reading the next. Both share parameters, routing,
and the layer transition. Over the reals, both orders give the same vocabulary logits. Streaming
state holds each layer's KDA recurrence or MLA cache. Input and output sequences are TorchLean
tensors.
-/

namespace KimiK3.LanguageModel

namespace Layers

/-- Causal states for a list of layers, one per layer (KDA and MLA states differ in shape). -/
def State (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank) : List (Fin cfg.numLayers) → Type
  | [] => Unit
  | index :: rest => (model.layer index).sequence.CausalState × State model rest

/-- Empty causal state for a segment of decoder layers. -/
noncomputable def initialState (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank) :
    (indices : List (Fin cfg.numLayers)) → State model indices
  | [] => ()
  | index :: rest => ((model.layer index).sequence.initialState, initialState model rest)

/-- Advance a list of layers by one token in depth order, updating each layer's causal state. -/
noncomputable def step (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank) :
    (indices : List (Fin cfg.numLayers)) → State model indices →
      AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim →
      State model indices × AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim
  | [], _, depth => ((), depth)
  | index :: rest, state, depth =>
      let first := (model.layer index).forwardToken model.activeExperts_le state.1 depth
      let second := step model rest state.2 first.2
      ((first.1, second.1), second.2)

/-- Layer-wise sequence evaluation equals token-wise evaluation of the same layers. -/
theorem scan_eq_fold (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (indices : List (Fin cfg.numLayers))
    (inputs : List (AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim)) :
    (CausalScan.run (step model indices) (initialState model indices) inputs).2 =
      indices.foldl (fun states index =>
        (model.layer index).forward model.activeExperts_le states) inputs := by
  induction indices generalizing inputs with
  | nil =>
      induction inputs with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons input rest ih => simpa [step, initialState, CausalScan.run] using ih
  | cons index rest ih =>
      -- Exchange the token and layer traversals by composing their causal scans.
      change (CausalScan.run (fun state input =>
        let first := (model.layer index).forwardToken model.activeExperts_le state.1 input
        let second := step model rest state.2 first.2
        ((first.1, second.1), second.2))
        ((model.layer index).sequence.initialState, initialState model rest) inputs).2 = _
      rw [CausalScan.run_compose]
      simp only
      rw [ih, ← BackboneLayer.forward_eq_scan]
      rfl

end Layers

/-- Causal state of the complete decoder, with one state for every configured layer. -/
abbrev CausalState (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank) :=
  Layers.State model (List.finRange cfg.numLayers)

/-- Start a decoder with empty KDA histories and MLA caches. -/
noncomputable def initialState (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank) : model.CausalState :=
  Layers.initialState model (List.finRange cfg.numLayers)

/-- Process one embedding through every decoder layer and return the next state with the token's
vocabulary logits. Repeating the call on the returned state gives autoregressive decoding. -/
noncomputable def step (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank) (state : model.CausalState)
    (embedding : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim]) : model.CausalState × Tensor ℝ [cfg.vocabSize] :=
  let result := Layers.step model (List.finRange cfg.numLayers) state
    (BackboneLayer.initialDepthState embedding)
  let hidden := RMSNorm.scale (result.2.retrieve model.finalQuery) model.finalNormScale
  (result.1, Tensor.vecmat hidden model.vocabularyHead)

/-- Run a fixed-length embedding tensor and return the state needed by the next chunk. -/
noncomputable def run {length : Nat} (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (state : model.CausalState) (embeddings : Tensor ℝ [length, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    model.CausalState × Tensor ℝ [length, cfg.vocabSize] :=
  let result := CausalScan.run model.step state
    (List.ofFn fun index => embeddings.unstack index)
  have hLength : result.2.length = length := by
    rw [CausalScan.outputs_length, List.length_ofFn]
  (result.1, Tensor.dim fun index => result.2.get ⟨index.val, by rw [hLength]; exact index.isLt⟩)

/-- Streaming from the initial state reproduces the full-sequence logits. It holds for every
sequence length and every parameter value, with sparse layers taking the model's own
deterministic routes. -/
theorem run_eq_logits {length : Nat} (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (embeddings : Tensor ℝ [length, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    (model.run model.initialState embeddings).2 = model.logits embeddings := by
  let inputs := List.ofFn fun index => Tensor.unstack embeddings index
  let final := (List.finRange cfg.numLayers).foldl
    (fun states index => (model.layer index).forward model.activeExperts_le states)
    (inputs.map BackboneLayer.initialDepthState)
  let finish := fun depth : AttnRes.BlockState ℝ cfg.hiddenDim =>
    Tensor.vecmat (RMSNorm.scale (depth.retrieve model.finalQuery) model.finalNormScale)
      model.vocabularyHead
  have hOutputs : (CausalScan.run model.step model.initialState inputs).2 = final.map finish := by
    -- Separate embedding preparation and logit projection from the shared decoder scan.
    change (CausalScan.run (fun state input =>
      let result := Layers.step model (List.finRange cfg.numLayers) state
        (BackboneLayer.initialDepthState input)
      (result.1, finish result.2))
      (Layers.initialState model (List.finRange cfg.numLayers)) inputs).2 = _
    rw [CausalScan.run_map_output]
    simp only
    exact congrArg (List.map finish)
      (Layers.scan_eq_fold model (List.finRange cfg.numLayers) _)
  simp only [run, logits, forwardHidden, Tensor.unstack_dim]
  congr 1
  funext index
  change (CausalScan.run model.step model.initialState inputs).2.get _ =
    finish (final.get _)
  simp only [hOutputs, List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_map]

private theorem concat_rows {α : Type} [Storage α] {leftLength rightLength : Nat}
    {shape : Shape} (left : Tensor α (leftLength :: shape))
    (right : Tensor α (rightLength :: shape)) :
    Tensor.concat left right =
      Tensor.dim (Fin.append (fun index => Tensor.unstack left index)
        (fun index => Tensor.unstack right index)) := by
  calc
    Tensor.concat left right = Tensor.dim (Tensor.concat left right).unstack :=
      (Tensor.dim_unstack _).symm
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      funext index
      refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun j => ?_) index
      · rw [Fin.append_left]
        simpa only [Fin.castAdd, Fin.castLE] using Tensor.unstack_concat_left left right i
      · rw [Fin.append_right]
        simpa only [Fin.natAdd] using Tensor.unstack_concat_right left right j

/-- Chunking an embedding tensor preserves every logit and the complete final decoder state.
The second chunk must start from the state returned by the first. -/
theorem run_append {leftLength rightLength : Nat} (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (state : model.CausalState) (left : Tensor ℝ [leftLength, cfg.hiddenDim])
    (right : Tensor ℝ [rightLength, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    model.run state (Tensor.concat left right) =
      let first := model.run state left
      let second := model.run first.1 right
      (second.1, Tensor.concat first.2 second.2) := by
  let first := CausalScan.run model.step state (List.ofFn fun index => Tensor.unstack left index)
  let second := CausalScan.run model.step first.1 (List.ofFn fun index => Tensor.unstack right index)
  have hFirst : first.2.length = leftLength := by
    rw [CausalScan.outputs_length, List.length_ofFn]
  have hInputs : (List.ofFn fun index => Tensor.unstack (Tensor.concat left right) index) =
      (List.ofFn fun index => Tensor.unstack left index) ++
        (List.ofFn fun index => Tensor.unstack right index) := by
    rw [concat_rows]
    simp only [Tensor.unstack_dim, List.ofFn_fin_append]
  have hScan : CausalScan.run model.step state
      (List.ofFn fun index => Tensor.unstack (Tensor.concat left right) index) =
      (second.1, first.2 ++ second.2) := by
    rw [hInputs, CausalScan.run_append]
  dsimp only [run]
  apply Prod.ext
  · change (CausalScan.run model.step state
      (List.ofFn fun index => Tensor.unstack (Tensor.concat left right) index)).1 =
        second.1
    have hState := congrArg Prod.fst hScan
    exact hState
  · dsimp only
    conv_rhs => rw [concat_rows]
    apply congrArg Tensor.dim
    funext index
    simp only [List.get_eq_getElem, Tensor.unstack_dim]
    rw [List.getElem_of_eq (congrArg Prod.snd hScan)]
    change (first.2 ++ second.2).get _ = _
    by_cases h : index.val < leftLength
    · simp [Fin.append, Fin.addCases, h, List.get_eq_getElem, hFirst]
      rfl
    · simp [Fin.append, Fin.addCases, h, List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_append, hFirst]
      rfl

module

public import KimiK3.Common
public import KimiK3.Sequence.Scan

/-!
# Block Attention Residuals

Retrieve a weighted mixture of earlier depth representations. RMS normalization enters only the
scores, and the weighted values are the original representations. Each depth state keeps
completed block summaries and the current partial block, with the embedding as an initial
source. Both growing-list and fixed-shape retrieval functions are defined below.

Reference: Kimi K3 technical report, Sections 2.1--2.2, pp. 4--6, Eqs. 1--10.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace KimiK3

open TorchLean
open FloatLib.Numerics (MathFunctions)
open Tensor

namespace AttnRes

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {modelDim : Nat}

/-- Positive softmax kernel `exp(qᵀ RMSNorm(k))` from Eq. 9. -/
def kernel (query key : Tensor α [modelDim]) : α :=
  MathFunctions.exp (Tensor.dot query (RMSNorm.unit key))

/-- Sum of the exponential scores that normalize the depth-attention weights. -/
def normalizer (query : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (sources : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) : α :=
  sources.foldl (fun total source => total + kernel query source) 0

/-- Depth-attention normalizers are positive whenever at least one source is present, so
real-valued AttnRes retrieval never divides by zero. -/
theorem normalizer_pos_of_ne_nil (query : Tensor ℝ [modelDim])
    (sources : List (Tensor ℝ [modelDim])) (hSources : sources ≠ []) :
    0 < normalizer query sources := by
  cases sources with
  | nil => exact (hSources rfl).elim
  | cons first rest =>
      simp only [normalizer, List.foldl_cons]
      clear hSources
      have hFirst : 0 < (0 : ℝ) + kernel query first := by
        change 0 < 0 + Real.exp _
        positivity
      generalize (0 : ℝ) + kernel query first = accumulator at hFirst ⊢
      induction rest generalizing accumulator with
      | nil => simpa using hFirst
      | cons source rest ih =>
          simp only [List.foldl_cons]
          apply ih
          exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hFirst (Real.exp_pos _).le

/--
Attention over depth representations. Callers always include the embedding, so `sources` is
nonempty.
-/
def attend (query : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (sources : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) : Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let denominator := normalizer query sources
  sources.foldl (fun output source =>
    let weight := kernel query source / denominator
    output + Tensor.map (fun value => weight * value) source)
    (Tensor.zeros [modelDim])

/-- Fixed-shape form of depth attention used at graph and backend boundaries.

Rows of `values` are the visible depth representations. They are RMS-normalized, scored against
the query, exponentiated, and normalized by their total mass, and the resulting weights multiply
the unnormalized sources in a vector--matrix product, as in Eq. 9--10.
-/
def attendPacked {sources : Nat} (hModel : 0 < modelDim)
    (query : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (values : Tensor α [sources, modelDim]) :
    Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let unitScale := Tensor.ones [modelDim]
  let normalized := Tensor.dim fun row =>
    RMSNorm.scalePositive hModel (Tensor.unstack values row) unitScale
  let transposed := normalized.permute (Shape.adjacentSwap [sources, modelDim] 0) [modelDim, sources]
  let scores := Tensor.vecmat query transposed
  let kernels := Tensor.exp scores
  let denominator := Tensor.sum kernels
  let weights := Tensor.map (fun weight => weight / denominator) kernels
  Tensor.vecmat weights values

/-- State retained by Block AttnRes while traversing layers. -/
structure BlockState (α : Type) [Storage α] (modelDim : Nat) where
  /-- Token embedding, always visible to depth attention. -/
  embedding : Tensor α [modelDim]
  /-- Sums of the completed AttnRes blocks. -/
  completedBlocks : List (Tensor α [modelDim])
  /-- Sum accumulated in the current, incomplete block. -/
  partialBlock : Tensor α [modelDim]
  /-- Number of decoder layers represented by `partialBlock`. -/
  partialSize : Nat

namespace BlockState

/-- A valid partial AttnRes block has not yet reached its block boundary. -/
def WF (state : BlockState α modelDim) (blockSize : Nat) : Prop :=
  state.partialSize < blockSize

/-- Sources in Eq. 10: embedding, completed block sums, and an optional current partial sum. -/
def sources (state : BlockState α modelDim) : List (Tensor α [modelDim]) :=
  state.embedding :: state.completedBlocks ++
    if state.partialSize = 0 then [] else [state.partialBlock]

omit [Context α] in
/-- Because the embedding is always included, every AttnRes source list is nonempty. -/
theorem sources_ne_nil (state : BlockState α modelDim) : state.sources ≠ [] := by
  simp [sources]

omit [Context α] in
/-- Source count is the embedding, completed blocks, and an optional partial block. -/
theorem sources_length (state : BlockState α modelDim) :
    state.sources.length =
      1 + state.completedBlocks.length + if state.partialSize = 0 then 0 else 1 := by
  by_cases hPartial : state.partialSize = 0 <;> simp [sources, hPartial]
    <;> omega

/-- Outputs of the AttnRes blocks so far. A partial block that has at least one layer counts as
the current last block. Token embeddings are not block outputs. -/
def blockOutputs (state : BlockState α modelDim) : List (Tensor α [modelDim]) :=
  state.completedBlocks ++ if state.partialSize = 0 then [] else [state.partialBlock]

omit [Context α] in
/-- There is one visible block output per completed block, plus one for the current partial block
when at least one layer has contributed to it. -/
theorem blockOutputs_length (state : BlockState α modelDim) :
    state.blockOutputs.length =
      state.completedBlocks.length + if state.partialSize = 0 then 0 else 1 := by
  by_cases h : state.partialSize = 0 <;> simp [blockOutputs, h]

/-- Every depth state has a positive real-valued attention normalizer, because the embedding is
always a source. -/
theorem normalizer_pos (state : BlockState ℝ modelDim)
    (query : Tensor ℝ [modelDim]) :
    0 < AttnRes.normalizer query state.sources := by
  apply normalizer_pos_of_ne_nil
  simp [sources]

/-- Retrieve the input to a layer using its learned depth pseudo-query. -/
def retrieve (state : BlockState α modelDim) (query : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  attend query state.sources

/--
Depth representations visible after the sequence mixer but before the channel mixer. Adding the
current sequence output to the partial block does not advance the decoder-layer counter.
-/
def sourcesAfterSequence (state : BlockState α modelDim)
    (sequenceOutput : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    List (Tensor α [modelDim]) :=
  state.embedding :: state.completedBlocks ++ [state.partialBlock + sequenceOutput]

/-- Retrieve the channel-mixer input after adding the current layer's sequence output. -/
def retrieveAfterSequence (state : BlockState α modelDim)
    (sequenceOutput query : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  attend query (state.sourcesAfterSequence sequenceOutput)

/--
Commit one complete decoder layer. Sequence-mixer and channel outputs belong to the same AttnRes
block, so `partialSize` advances once after both submodules have run.
-/
def finishLayer (state : BlockState α modelDim) (blockSize : Nat)
    (sequenceOutput channelOutput : Tensor α [modelDim]) : BlockState α modelDim :=
  let partialSum := state.partialBlock + sequenceOutput + channelOutput
  if state.partialSize + 1 = blockSize then
    { state with
      completedBlocks := state.completedBlocks ++ [partialSum]
      partialBlock := Tensor.zeros [modelDim]
      partialSize := 0 }
  else
    { state with partialBlock := partialSum, partialSize := state.partialSize + 1 }

/-- At a block boundary, the accumulated sum is committed and the partial block is reset. -/
theorem finishLayer_of_boundary (state : BlockState α modelDim) (blockSize : Nat)
    (sequenceOutput channelOutput : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (hBoundary : state.partialSize + 1 = blockSize) :
    state.finishLayer blockSize sequenceOutput channelOutput =
      { state with
        completedBlocks := state.completedBlocks ++
          [state.partialBlock + sequenceOutput + channelOutput]
        partialBlock := Tensor.zeros [modelDim]
        partialSize := 0 } := by
  simp [finishLayer, hBoundary]

/-- Away from a boundary, the layer output is accumulated without committing a block. -/
theorem finishLayer_of_not_boundary (state : BlockState α modelDim) (blockSize : Nat)
    (sequenceOutput channelOutput : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (hBoundary : state.partialSize + 1 ≠ blockSize) :
    state.finishLayer blockSize sequenceOutput channelOutput =
      { state with
        partialBlock := state.partialBlock + sequenceOutput + channelOutput
        partialSize := state.partialSize + 1 } := by
  simp [finishLayer, hBoundary]

/-- Finishing a layer advances the block position by one, wrapping to zero at the boundary. -/
private theorem finishLayer_partialSize (state : BlockState α modelDim) (blockSize : Nat)
    (sequenceOutput channelOutput : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    (state.finishLayer blockSize sequenceOutput channelOutput).partialSize =
      if state.partialSize + 1 = blockSize then 0 else state.partialSize + 1 := by
  by_cases hFull : state.partialSize + 1 = blockSize
  · simp [finishLayer, hFull]
  · simp [finishLayer, hFull]

/-- Committing a decoder layer preserves the block-position invariant, so a state never grows past
its AttnRes block size. -/
theorem finishLayer_wf (state : BlockState α modelDim) (blockSize : Nat)
    (sequenceOutput channelOutput : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (hState : state.WF blockSize) :
    (state.finishLayer blockSize sequenceOutput channelOutput).WF blockSize := by
  rw [WF] at hState
  rw [WF, finishLayer_partialSize]
  split
  · omega
  · omega

end BlockState

end AttnRes

end KimiK3

module

public import KimiK3.Sequence.Scan

public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sigmoid

/-!
# Kimi Delta Attention

`update` decays the recurrent matrix and writes a key-aligned value correction. `Layer` adds
the learned projections, newest-first short-convolution windows, normalization, and output
gating. Sequence and streaming functions share this token transition, and their scan laws
compare runs with the same operations and inputs.

Reference: Kimi K3 technical report, Sections 2.1--2.2, pp. 4--6, Eqs. 1--10.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace KimiK3

open TorchLean
open FloatLib.Numerics (MathFunctions)
open Tensor

/-- Parameters of one causal depthwise short convolution. -/
structure ShortConv (α : Type) [Storage α] (width channels : Nat) where
  /-- One scalar coefficient for each tap and channel. -/
  weight : Tensor α [width, channels]
  /-- Per-channel bias. -/
  bias : Tensor α [channels]

namespace ShortConv

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {width channels : Nat}

/--
Apply a short convolution to a newest-first projected-token history.  Missing old tokens are zero
padded, so the definition is causal for every history length.
-/
def forward (conv : ShortConv α width channels)
    (history : List (Tensor α [channels])) : Tensor α [channels] :=
  let zero : Tensor α [channels] := Tensor.zeros [channels]
  Tensor.dim (fun channel => Tensor.scalar <|
    (List.finRange width).foldl (fun total tap =>
      total + Tensor.getScalar (history.getD tap.val zero) channel * Tensor.get2 conv.weight tap channel)
      (Tensor.getScalar conv.bias channel))

/-- A short convolution never reads beyond its window. Truncating the history keeps the addition
order and every scalar operation, so this holds in rounded scalar contexts too. -/
theorem forward_take (conv : ShortConv α width channels)
    (history : List (Tensor α [channels])) :
    conv.forward (history.take width) = conv.forward history := by
  unfold forward
  apply congrArg Tensor.dim
  funext channel
  apply congrArg Tensor.scalar
  apply List.foldl_ext
  intro total tap _
  simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_take_of_lt tap.isLt]

/-- Apply the causal convolution to a full newest-first window.

The leading axis is the tap axis: row zero is the current projected token and later rows are
successively older tokens. Streaming code keeps this fixed-size window, while the list-based
`forward` serves the zero-padded causal specification. Here the bias is added after the tap sum
(`forward` starts its fold from the bias), so rounded results need not agree with `forward`.
-/
def forwardWindow (conv : ShortConv α width channels) (_hWidth : 0 < width)
    (window : Tensor α [width, channels]) :
    Tensor α [channels] :=
  Tensor.zipWith (· + ·)
    (Tensor.reduce .sum (window * conv.weight) [⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ 1⟩] false) conv.bias

end ShortConv

/-- Input to the mathematical single-head KDA recurrence in Eq. 1. -/
structure KDA.Input (α : Type) [Storage α] (keyDim valueDim : Nat) where
  /-- Query used to read the updated recurrent matrix. -/
  query : Tensor α [keyDim]
  /-- Unit-regularized key used by the delta update. -/
  key : Tensor α [keyDim]
  /-- Value written into the recurrent matrix. -/
  value : Tensor α [valueDim]
  /-- Coordinate-wise multiplicative retention. -/
  retention : Tensor α [keyDim]
  /-- Scalar delta-rule write gate. -/
  writeStrength : α

namespace KDA

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {keyDim valueDim : Nat}

/-- Recurrent KDA state `S ∈ R^(d_k × d_v)`. -/
abbrev State (α : Type) [Storage α] (keyDim valueDim : Nat) :=
  Tensor α [keyDim, valueDim]

/--
One single-head KDA recurrence (Eq. 1):

`S_t = (I - β_t k_t k_tᵀ) Diag(α_t) S_(t-1) + β_t k_t v_tᵀ`.

It is implemented in the factorized form of an efficient kernel: decay the rows of the state,
read the decayed state with the key, subtract the key-aligned correction, then add the rank-one
write.
-/
def update (state : State α keyDim valueDim) (input : KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim) :
    State α keyDim valueDim :=
  let decayed := Tensor.dim fun row => Tensor.dim fun column => Tensor.scalar <|
    Tensor.getScalar input.retention row * Tensor.get2 state row column
  let correction := Tensor.vecmat input.key decayed
  Tensor.zipWith (· + ·)
    (Tensor.zipWith (· - ·) decayed
      (Tensor.zipWith (· * ·)
        (Tensor.full [keyDim, valueDim] input.writeStrength)
        (Tensor.matrix fun row col => input.key.getScalar row * correction.getScalar col)))
    (Tensor.zipWith (· * ·)
      (Tensor.full [keyDim, valueDim] input.writeStrength)
      (Tensor.matrix fun row col => input.key.getScalar row * input.value.getScalar col))

/-- Coordinate form of the factorized KDA update.

Its correction coordinate reads the key from the already decayed state, so decay comes before the
delta correction.
-/
theorem update_get2 (state : State ℝ keyDim valueDim)
    (input : KDA.Input ℝ keyDim valueDim) (row : Fin keyDim) (column : Fin valueDim) :
  let decayed := Tensor.dim fun source => Tensor.dim fun target => Tensor.scalar
    (Tensor.getScalar input.retention source * Tensor.get2 state source target)
  Tensor.get2 (update state input) row column =
      Tensor.getScalar input.retention row * Tensor.get2 state row column -
        input.writeStrength * Tensor.getScalar input.key row *
          Tensor.getScalar (Tensor.vecmat input.key decayed) column +
        input.writeStrength * Tensor.getScalar input.key row *
          Tensor.getScalar input.value column := by
  simp [update, Tensor.matrix, Tensor.get2_eq_getScalar_unstack]
  ring

/-- Read the current output after the state update: `o_t = S_tᵀ q_t`. -/
def read (state : State α keyDim valueDim) (query : Tensor α [keyDim]) :
    Tensor α [valueDim] :=
  Tensor.vecmat query state

/-- One recurrence step returns the updated state and its current-token output. -/
def step (state : State α keyDim valueDim) (input : KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim) :
    State α keyDim valueDim × Tensor α [valueDim] :=
  let next := update state input
  (next, read next input.query)

/-- Sequential semantics for a projected KDA sequence. -/
def run (state : State α keyDim valueDim) (inputs : List (KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim)) :=
  CausalScan.run step state inputs

/-- A single-head KDA scan emits one value vector per projected token. -/
theorem run_outputs_length (state : State α keyDim valueDim)
    (inputs : List (KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim)) :
    (run state inputs).2.length = inputs.length := by
  exact CausalScan.outputs_length step state inputs

/-- Chunk boundaries do not change the KDA recurrence or emitted outputs. -/
theorem run_append (state : State α keyDim valueDim)
    (left right : List (KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim)) :
    run state (left ++ right) =
      let first := run state left
      let second := run first.1 right
      (second.1, first.2 ++ second.2) :=
  CausalScan.run_append step state left right

/-- Lower-bounded real retention from Eq. 5. -/
noncomputable def retentionReal (logFloor logScale logit : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (logFloor * Real.sigmoid (Real.exp logScale * logit))

/--
K3's retention parameterization lies strictly between `exp(logFloor)` and one, so no channel's
retention can approach zero.
-/
theorem retentionReal_bounds {logFloor : ℝ} (hFloor : logFloor < 0) (logScale logit : ℝ) :
    Real.exp logFloor < retentionReal logFloor logScale logit ∧
      retentionReal logFloor logScale logit < 1 := by
  have hSigPos : 0 < Real.sigmoid (Real.exp logScale * logit) := Real.sigmoid_pos _
  have hSigLt : Real.sigmoid (Real.exp logScale * logit) < 1 := Real.sigmoid_lt_one _
  have hLower : logFloor < logFloor * Real.sigmoid (Real.exp logScale * logit) := by
    nlinarith
  have hUpper : logFloor * Real.sigmoid (Real.exp logScale * logit) < 0 := by
    exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hFloor hSigPos
  constructor
  · exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hLower
  · simpa [retentionReal] using Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr hUpper

/-- With the paper's floor `logFloor = -5`, every one-step retention lies strictly between
`exp(-5)` and `1`. -/
theorem paper_retention_bounds (logScale logit : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-5) < retentionReal (-5) logScale logit ∧
      retentionReal (-5) logScale logit < 1 := by
  exact retentionReal_bounds (by norm_num) logScale logit

end KDA

/-- Projection and gating parameters for one KDA head. -/
structure KDA.Head (α : Type) [Storage α] (modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank : Nat) where
  /-- Model-to-query projection. -/
  queryWeight : Tensor α [modelDim, keyDim]
  /-- Model-to-key projection. -/
  keyWeight : Tensor α [modelDim, keyDim]
  /-- Model-to-value projection. -/
  valueWeight : Tensor α [modelDim, valueDim]
  /-- Depthwise causal convolution for projected queries. -/
  queryConv : ShortConv α convWidth keyDim
  /-- Depthwise causal convolution for projected keys. -/
  keyConv : ShortConv α convWidth keyDim
  /-- Depthwise causal convolution for projected values. -/
  valueConv : ShortConv α convWidth valueDim
  /-- Projection producing the scalar delta-rule write gate. -/
  betaWeight : Tensor α [modelDim]
  /-- First factor of the low-rank retention projection. -/
  decayDown : Tensor α [modelDim, decayRank]
  /-- Second factor of the low-rank retention projection. -/
  decayUp : Tensor α [decayRank, keyDim]
  /-- Coordinate-wise retention bias. -/
  decayBias : Tensor α [keyDim]
  /-- Learned logarithm of the retention-logit scale. -/
  decayLogScale : α

namespace KDA.Head

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank : Nat}

/-- Build the recurrence input from the three short-convolution outputs: swish activations, L2
normalization of query and key, and the retention and write gates of the current token. -/
def activate (head : KDA.Head α modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (current : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (qPre kPre : Tensor α [keyDim]) (vPre : Tensor α [valueDim]) :
    KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim :=
  let query := Tensor.normalizeL2 (Tensor.map Activation.silu qPre)
    Normalize.l2Epsilon
  let key := Tensor.normalizeL2 (Tensor.map Activation.silu kPre)
    Normalize.l2Epsilon
  let value := Tensor.map Activation.silu vPre
  let decayLogit :=
    Tensor.zipWith (· + ·) (Tensor.vecmat (Tensor.vecmat current head.decayDown) head.decayUp)
      head.decayBias
  let scale := MathFunctions.exp head.decayLogScale
  let retention := Tensor.map
    (fun z => MathFunctions.exp (logFloor * Context.sigmoid (scale * z))) decayLogit
  let beta := Context.sigmoid (Tensor.dot current head.betaWeight)
  { query, key, value, retention, writeStrength := beta }

/-- Prepare one recurrence step, projecting only the tokens read by the convolution window. -/
def prepare (head : KDA.Head α modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (current : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (history : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) : KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim :=
  let window := (current :: history).take convWidth
  head.activate logFloor current
    (head.queryConv.forward (window.map (Tensor.vecmat · head.queryWeight)))
    (head.keyConv.forward (window.map (Tensor.vecmat · head.keyWeight)))
    (head.valueConv.forward (window.map (Tensor.vecmat · head.valueWeight)))

/-- Projecting only the convolution window agrees with projecting the complete history, with no
associativity or real-arithmetic assumption. -/
theorem prepare_eq_full_history (head : KDA.Head α modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (current : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (history : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) :
    head.prepare logFloor current history = head.activate logFloor current
      (head.queryConv.forward ((current :: history).map (Tensor.vecmat · head.queryWeight)))
      (head.keyConv.forward ((current :: history).map (Tensor.vecmat · head.keyWeight)))
      (head.valueConv.forward ((current :: history).map (Tensor.vecmat · head.valueWeight))) := by
  simp [prepare, List.map_take, ShortConv.forward_take]

/-- Construct one head's recurrence input from a fixed newest-first model-width window.

This is the tensor ABI of the executable graph. One matrix multiplication projects the whole
window before the three depthwise convolutions. L2 normalization uses the `10⁻⁶` stabilizer of
the released FlashKDA reference and CUDA kernel.
-/
def prepareWindow (head : KDA.Head α modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (hWidth : 0 < convWidth) (logFloor : α)
    (window : Tensor α [convWidth, modelDim]) :
    KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim :=
  let current := Tensor.unstack window ⟨0, hWidth⟩
  let qPre := head.queryConv.forwardWindow hWidth (Tensor.matmul window head.queryWeight)
  let kPre := head.keyConv.forwardWindow hWidth (Tensor.matmul window head.keyWeight)
  let vPre := head.valueConv.forwardWindow hWidth (Tensor.matmul window head.valueWeight)
  head.activate logFloor current qPre kPre vPre

end KDA.Head

/-- Complete multi-head KDA layer with a full-rank output gate (Eq. 6). -/
structure KDA.Layer (α : Type) [Storage α]
    (modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank : Nat) where
  /-- Parameters indexed by attention head. -/
  head : Fin heads → KDA.Head α modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank
  /-- Full-rank output-gate projection. -/
  gateWeight : Tensor α [modelDim, heads, valueDim]
  /-- Per-head projection back to model width. -/
  outputWeight : Tensor α [heads, valueDim, modelDim]
  /-- Per-head RMSNorm scale applied before output gating. -/
  outputNormScale : Tensor α [heads, valueDim]

namespace KDA.Layer

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank : Nat}

/-- State carried by every KDA head.

Heads run along the leading tensor axis.  A packed tensor, rather than a function
`Fin heads → KDA.State`, makes the specification state the same value that GraphSpec and the
runtime pass around.  `Tensor.unstack state head` still gives one head's matrix.
-/
abbrev State (α : Type) [Storage α] (heads keyDim valueDim : Nat) :=
  Tensor α [heads, keyDim, valueDim]

/-- Full-rank output gates, arranged as one row per attention head.

In the published layout the gate weight has shape `(modelDim, heads, valueDim)`, so each head
multiplies the hidden vector by its own `(modelDim, valueDim)` slice and applies a sigmoid.  Its
packed result has the same layout as the GraphSpec graph.
-/
def gates (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    Tensor α [heads, valueDim] :=
  Tensor.dim fun head =>
    Tensor.map Context.sigmoid <|
      Tensor.vecmat x <| Tensor.dim fun input =>
        Tensor.unstack (Tensor.unstack layer.gateWeight input) head

/-- Read every recurrent head, normalize it, apply its output gate, and project back to model
width.

It takes the already updated state and no projection or convolution parameters, so
GraphSpec reuses it as the target of the post-update subgraph.
-/
def readout (state : Tensor α [heads, keyDim, valueDim])
    (query : Tensor α [heads, keyDim])
    (gate : Tensor α [heads, valueDim])
    (outputWeight : Tensor α [heads, valueDim, modelDim])
    (outputNormScale : Tensor α [heads, valueDim]) :
    Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let headOutput := Tensor.dim fun h =>
    RMSNorm.scale (KDA.read (Tensor.unstack state h) (Tensor.unstack query h))
      (Tensor.unstack outputNormScale h)
  let gated := gate * headOutput
  let projectedHeads := Tensor.dim fun h =>
    Tensor.vecmat (Tensor.unstack gated h) (Tensor.unstack outputWeight h)
  Tensor.dim fun output => Tensor.scalar <|
    (List.finRange heads).foldl (fun total head =>
      total + Tensor.getScalar (Tensor.unstack projectedHeads head) output) 0

/-- Complete one layer step after every head's recurrence inputs have been prepared.

`step` and `stepWindow` both call it, so the list-based causal specification and the
fixed-window graph target share one copy of the recurrence, output normalization, full-rank gate,
and output projection.
-/
def stepPrepared (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (state : State α heads keyDim valueDim) (x : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (prepared : Fin heads → KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim) :
    State α heads keyDim valueDim × Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let next := Tensor.dim fun h => KDA.update (Tensor.unstack state h) (prepared h)
  let query := Tensor.dim fun h => (prepared h).query
  (next, readout next query (layer.gates x) layer.outputWeight layer.outputNormScale)

/-- One token step through every KDA head and the shared output projection. -/
def step (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (history : List (Tensor α [modelDim]))
    (state : State α heads keyDim valueDim) (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    State α heads keyDim valueDim × Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  layer.stepPrepared state x fun head => (layer.head head).prepare logFloor x history

/-- One complete KDA layer step from a fixed newest-first model-width window. -/
def stepWindow (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (hWidth : 0 < convWidth) (logFloor : α)
    (window : Tensor α [convWidth, modelDim])
    (state : State α heads keyDim valueDim) :
    State α heads keyDim valueDim × Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let current := Tensor.unstack window ⟨0, hWidth⟩
  layer.stepPrepared state current fun head =>
    (layer.head head).prepareWindow hWidth logFloor window

/-- Appending one row to a positive-width window prefix restores the original width. -/
theorem rollWindow_shape_eq (hWidth : 0 < convWidth) :
    ([1 + (convWidth - 1), modelDim] : Shape) =
      [convWidth, modelDim] := by
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Uncast tensor operation underlying `rollWindow`. -/
def rollWindowRaw (current : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (previous : Tensor α [convWidth, modelDim]) :
    Tensor α [1 + (convWidth - 1), modelDim] :=
  let currentRow : Tensor α [1, modelDim] :=
    Tensor.reshape current _ (by simp [Shape.size])
  let retained := Tensor.take previous 0 (convWidth - 1) (by simp [Shape.axisSize])
  Tensor.concat currentRow retained

/-- Advance the fixed newest-first short-convolution window by one token.

The current token becomes row zero, the previous first `convWidth - 1` rows move back by one
position, and the oldest row is discarded.  This is the transition the executable graph refines.
-/
def rollWindow (hWidth : 0 < convWidth)
    (current : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (previous : Tensor α [convWidth, modelDim]) :
    Tensor α [convWidth, modelDim] :=
  KDA.Layer.rollWindow_shape_eq hWidth ▸ KDA.Layer.rollWindowRaw current previous

/-- Streaming KDA state: recurrent head matrices together with newest-first token history for the
causal short convolutions. -/
abbrev ScanState (α : Type) [Storage α] (modelDim heads keyDim valueDim : Nat) :=
  State α heads keyDim valueDim × List (Tensor α [modelDim])

/-- One streaming layer step, including the short-convolution history update. -/
def scanStep (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (state : ScanState α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim)
    (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    ScanState α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim × Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let result := layer.step logFloor state.2 state.1 x
  ((result.1, x :: state.2), result.2)

/-- A streaming KDA step puts the current token at the front of the convolution history. -/
theorem scanStep_history
    (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (state : ScanState α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim)
    (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    (layer.scanStep logFloor state x).1.2 = x :: state.2 := by
  rfl

/-- Run a KDA layer from a given streaming state. -/
def run (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (state : ScanState α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim)
    (tokens : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) :=
  CausalScan.run (layer.scanStep logFloor) state tokens

/-- A multi-head KDA scan emits one model-width vector per token. -/
theorem run_outputs_length
    (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (state : ScanState α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim)
    (tokens : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) :
    (layer.run logFloor state tokens).2.length = tokens.length := by
  exact CausalScan.outputs_length (layer.scanStep logFloor) state tokens

/-- Chunked KDA execution preserves the recurrent matrices, convolution history, and outputs. -/
theorem run_append
    (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (state : ScanState α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim)
    (left right : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) :
    layer.run logFloor state (left ++ right) =
      let first := layer.run logFloor state left
      let second := layer.run logFloor first.1 right
      (second.1, first.2 ++ second.2) :=
  CausalScan.run_append (layer.scanStep logFloor) state left right

end KDA.Layer

module

public import KimiK3.Common
public import KimiK3.Sequence.Scan
public import TorchLean.Tensor.Layers.Activation
public import TorchLean.Tensor.Layers.Softmax

/-!
# Gated Multi-head Latent Attention

Each cache entry stores a compressed key/value vector and an unrotated shared key. Heads
reconstruct their keys and values from those entries. The current token is appended before
attention. `step` uses a growing list cache for the causal proofs, and `stepFixed` uses packed
tensors for the fixed-context graph. Each is proved against its own consumer, and no theorem
relates the two caches.

Reference: Kimi K3 technical report, Sections 2.1--2.2, pp. 4--6, Eqs. 1--10.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace KimiK3

open TorchLean
open FloatLib.Numerics (MathFunctions)
open Tensor

/-- One cached MLA token: a normalized KV latent and a shared, unrotated key component. -/
structure GatedMLA.Entry (α : Type) [Storage α] (kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim : Nat) where
  /-- Shared normalized KV latent from which every head reconstructs keys and values. -/
  latent : Tensor α [kvLatentDim]
  /-- Shared unrotated key coordinates retained for attention scoring. -/
  sharedKey : Tensor α [sharedKeyDim]

/-- Gated MLA parameters.  K3 uses NoPE attention, so there are no positional-encoding weights. -/
structure GatedMLA (α : Type) [Storage α]
    (modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim : Nat) where
  /-- Low-rank query projection. -/
  queryDown : Tensor α [modelDim, queryLatentDim]
  /-- RMSNorm scale for the compressed query. -/
  queryNormScale : Tensor α [queryLatentDim]
  /-- Shared compressed key/value projection. -/
  kvDown : Tensor α [modelDim, kvLatentDim]
  /-- RMSNorm scale for the compressed key/value latent. -/
  kvNormScale : Tensor α [kvLatentDim]
  /-- Projection producing the unrotated shared key. -/
  sharedKeyDown : Tensor α [modelDim, sharedKeyDim]
  /-- Content-query up-projection, with one matrix per head. -/
  queryContentUp : Tensor α [heads, queryLatentDim, contentKeyDim]
  /-- Shared-query up-projection, with one matrix per head. -/
  querySharedUp : Tensor α [heads, queryLatentDim, sharedKeyDim]
  /-- Content-key up-projection, with one matrix per head. -/
  keyUp : Tensor α [heads, kvLatentDim, contentKeyDim]
  /-- Value up-projection, with one matrix per head. -/
  valueUp : Tensor α [heads, kvLatentDim, valueDim]
  /-- Full-rank per-head output gate. -/
  gateWeight : Tensor α [modelDim, heads, valueDim]
  /-- Per-head value projection back to model width. -/
  outputWeight : Tensor α [heads, valueDim, modelDim]

namespace GatedMLA

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim : Nat}

/-- A list of cache entries, each holding the two shared representations every head is
reconstructed from. -/
abbrev Cache (α : Type) [Storage α] (kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim : Nat) :=
  List (Entry α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim)

/-- Normalized global attention for one head over its compressed cache. -/
def attend
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (head : Fin heads)
    (queryLatent : Tensor α [queryLatentDim])
    (cache : Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim) : Tensor α [valueDim] :=
  let queryContent := Tensor.vecmat queryLatent (Tensor.unstack layer.queryContentUp head)
  let queryShared := Tensor.vecmat queryLatent (Tensor.unstack layer.querySharedUp head)
  let score := fun entry =>
    MathFunctions.exp ((Tensor.dot queryContent
      (Tensor.vecmat entry.latent (Tensor.unstack layer.keyUp head)) +
      Tensor.dot queryShared entry.sharedKey) /
      MathFunctions.sqrt (contentKeyDim + sharedKeyDim : α))
  let denominator := cache.foldl (fun total entry => total + score entry) 0
  cache.foldl (fun output entry =>
    let weight := score entry / denominator
    output + Tensor.map (fun value => weight * value)
      (Tensor.vecmat entry.latent (Tensor.unstack layer.valueUp head)))
    (Tensor.zeros [valueDim])

/-- One complete Gated MLA step at a fixed context length.

Here the caches are rank-two tensors and all heads run in one batched calculation, which is the form
the typed executable graph is proved against.  Returns both caches with the current token
appended, together with the projected model output.
-/
def stepFixed (pastTokens : Nat)
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (pastLatentCache : Tensor α [pastTokens, kvLatentDim])
    (pastSharedKeyCache : Tensor α [pastTokens, sharedKeyDim])
    (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) (scoreScale : α) :
    Tensor α [pastTokens + 1, kvLatentDim] ×
      Tensor α [pastTokens + 1, sharedKeyDim] ×
      Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let queryProjected := Tensor.vecmat x layer.queryDown
  let queryLatent := RMSNorm.scale queryProjected layer.queryNormScale
  let kvProjected := Tensor.vecmat x layer.kvDown
  let currentKV := RMSNorm.scale kvProjected layer.kvNormScale
  let currentShared := Tensor.vecmat x layer.sharedKeyDown
  let currentKVRow : Tensor α [1, kvLatentDim] :=
    Tensor.reshape currentKV _ (by simp [Shape.size])
  let currentSharedRow : Tensor α [1, sharedKeyDim] :=
    Tensor.reshape currentShared _ (by simp [Shape.size])
  let latentCache := Tensor.concat pastLatentCache currentKVRow
  let sharedKeyCache := Tensor.concat pastSharedKeyCache currentSharedRow
  let queryRow : Tensor α [1, queryLatentDim] := Tensor.dim fun _ => queryLatent
  let queryBatch := Tensor.repeatLeading heads queryRow
  let latentBatch := Tensor.repeatLeading heads latentCache
  let sharedBatch := Tensor.repeatLeading heads sharedKeyCache
  let sameBatch := Shape.CanBroadcastTo.refl [heads]
  let queryContent := Tensor.batchMatmul sameBatch sameBatch queryBatch layer.queryContentUp
  let queryShared := Tensor.batchMatmul sameBatch sameBatch queryBatch layer.querySharedUp
  let keys := Tensor.batchMatmul sameBatch sameBatch latentBatch layer.keyUp
  let values := Tensor.batchMatmul sameBatch sameBatch latentBatch layer.valueUp
  let keysTransposed := keys.permute (Shape.adjacentSwap [heads, pastTokens + 1, contentKeyDim] 1)
    [heads, contentKeyDim, pastTokens + 1]
    (Shape.permute_adjacentSwap [heads, pastTokens + 1, contentKeyDim] 1).symm
  let sharedTransposed := sharedBatch.permute (Shape.adjacentSwap [heads, pastTokens + 1, sharedKeyDim] 1)
    [heads, sharedKeyDim, pastTokens + 1]
    (Shape.permute_adjacentSwap [heads, pastTokens + 1, sharedKeyDim] 1).symm
  let contentScores := Tensor.batchMatmul sameBatch sameBatch queryContent keysTransposed
  let sharedScores := Tensor.batchMatmul sameBatch sameBatch queryShared sharedTransposed
  let scoreShape : Shape := [heads, 1, pastTokens + 1]
  let scores := Tensor.zipWith (· * ·) (Tensor.full scoreShape scoreScale)
    (Tensor.zipWith (· + ·) contentScores sharedScores)
  let headOutput3 := Tensor.batchMatmul sameBatch sameBatch
    (Tensor.softmax scores ⟨2, by simp⟩) values
  let headOutput : Tensor α [heads, valueDim] :=
    Tensor.reshape headOutput3 _ (by simp [Shape.size])
  let gateMatrix : Tensor α [modelDim, heads * valueDim] :=
    Tensor.reshape layer.gateWeight _ (by simp [Shape.size])
  let gateFlat := Tensor.vecmat x gateMatrix
  let gate : Tensor α [heads, valueDim] :=
    Tensor.sigmoid (Tensor.reshape gateFlat _ (by simp [Shape.size]))
  let gatedHeads := Tensor.zipWith (· * ·) gate headOutput
  let gatedFlat : Tensor α [heads * valueDim] :=
    Tensor.reshape gatedHeads _ (by simp [Shape.size])
  let outputMatrix : Tensor α [heads * valueDim, modelDim] :=
    Tensor.reshape layer.outputWeight _ (by simp [Shape.size, Nat.mul_assoc])
  (latentCache, sharedKeyCache, Tensor.vecmat gatedFlat outputMatrix)

/-- One causal MLA token step, which appends the current entry before evaluating attention. -/
def step
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (cache : Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim) (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim × Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let queryLatent := RMSNorm.scale (Tensor.vecmat x layer.queryDown) layer.queryNormScale
  let currentKV := RMSNorm.scale (Tensor.vecmat x layer.kvDown) layer.kvNormScale
  let current : Entry α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim :=
    { latent := currentKV, sharedKey := Tensor.vecmat x layer.sharedKeyDown }
  let cache' := cache ++ [current]
  let headOutput := fun h => layer.attend h queryLatent cache'
  let gate := fun h channel => Context.sigmoid <|
    (List.finRange modelDim).foldl (fun total input =>
      total + Tensor.getScalar x input * Tensor.get2 (Tensor.unstack layer.gateWeight input) h channel) 0
  let output := Tensor.dim (fun feature => Tensor.scalar <|
    (List.finRange heads).foldl (fun acrossHeads h =>
      (List.finRange valueDim).foldl (fun total channel =>
        total + gate h channel * Tensor.getScalar (headOutput h) channel *
          Tensor.get2 (Tensor.unstack layer.outputWeight h) channel feature) acrossHeads) 0)
  (cache', output)

/-- One MLA step appends one entry to the streaming cache. -/
theorem step_cache_length
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (cache : Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim) (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    (layer.step cache x).1.length = cache.length + 1 := by
  simp [step]

/-- An MLA token step keeps the old cache as a prefix. -/
theorem step_cache_prefix
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (cache : Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim) (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    cache <+: (layer.step cache x).1 := by
  simp [step]

/-- Running MLA over a token list grows the compressed cache by the list's length. -/
theorem run_cache_length
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (cache : Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim)
    (tokens : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) :
    (CausalScan.run layer.step cache tokens).1.length = cache.length + tokens.length := by
  induction tokens generalizing cache with
  | nil => simp
  | cons token rest ih =>
      simp only [CausalScan.run]
      rw [ih]
      rw [step_cache_length]
      simp [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]

/-- Chunking a Gated MLA causal pass preserves its cache and outputs. -/
theorem run_append
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (cache : Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim)
    (left right : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) :
    CausalScan.run layer.step cache (left ++ right) =
      let first := CausalScan.run layer.step cache left
      let second := CausalScan.run layer.step first.1 right
      (second.1, first.2 ++ second.2) :=
  CausalScan.run_append layer.step cache left right

end GatedMLA

end KimiK3

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic

/-!
# MOPD rewards

The MOPD reward of a sampled token is the clipped teacher-to-student log probability ratio.
The probability subtype excludes zero, so the logarithm is always defined. Theorems below prove
the reward interval and show the reward vanishes when the two probabilities agree. Teacher selection
and the runtime stop-gradient are outside this file.

Reference: Kimi K3 technical report, Section 2.5 and Sections 3--4, pp. 10--14.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace KimiK3

namespace MOPD

/-- A strictly positive probability, safe inside the logarithm of the MOPD reward.

Teacher and student probabilities in Eq. 15 come from softmax distributions, so they are
strictly positive. This is Mathlib's interval subtype.
-/
abbrev StrictProbability := Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1

/-- Symmetric clipping to `[-bound, bound]`. -/
noncomputable def clip (bound value : ℝ) : ℝ := max (-bound) (min bound value)

/-- Per-token teacher/student reward from Eq. 15, before the stop-gradient annotation. -/
noncomputable def reward (maxReward : ℝ)
    (teacherProbability studentProbability : StrictProbability) : ℝ :=
  clip maxReward (Real.log ((teacherProbability : ℝ) / studentProbability))

/-- Clipping does not change a value already inside the requested symmetric interval. -/
theorem clip_eq_self {bound value : ℝ} (hlower : -bound ≤ value) (hupper : value ≤ bound) :
    clip bound value = value := by
  rw [clip, min_eq_right hupper, max_eq_right hlower]

/-- Clipping enforces the report's reward interval for every log-ratio. -/
theorem reward_mem_interval {maxReward : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ maxReward)
    (teacherProbability studentProbability : StrictProbability) :
    -maxReward ≤ reward maxReward teacherProbability studentProbability ∧
      reward maxReward teacherProbability studentProbability ≤ maxReward := by
  constructor
  · exact le_max_left _ _
  · exact max_le ((neg_nonpos.mpr h).trans h) (min_le_left _ _)

/-- A teacher and student assigning the same probability receive zero MOPD reward. -/
@[simp]
theorem reward_self {maxReward : ℝ} (hMaxReward : 0 ≤ maxReward)
    (probability : StrictProbability) :
    reward maxReward probability probability = 0 := by
  have hne : (probability : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt probability.property.1
  rw [reward, div_self hne, Real.log_one]
  exact clip_eq_self (neg_nonpos.mpr hMaxReward) hMaxReward

end MOPD

end KimiK3
